translation_policy: Other languages are present only where a source gives them (game text, codex, wiki); authored copy has English only.
summary: Graceful, composed, warm and honest; a touch of the divine as an accent; admits failure and invites people in; never talks down.

rules.text: Composed and graceful: short, calm sentences, no shouting.
Warm and inviting, addressing the reader like a teammate ('join us', 'with you').
Plain and honest: say what you see, then say how to fix it.
Quietly confident, never boastful; confidence comes from preparation.
A light touch of the divine and the artistic (grace, aura, beauty, heaven), used as an accent, not as every sentence.
One idea per sentence; pauses carried by an ellipsis only in dramatic moments.
First person plural for the product team and 'you' for the reader; never talk down.
Admit a failure in one sentence and move to the next step.
Credit training and effort over talent.
Invite people in ('I'd like to join', 'fight with you'); ask for help openly.
Keep a little elegance in the wording (a precise verb, a clean image).
Give the hard fact first (no way they could win like this) and offer a path.
Do not talk down to the user as a mortal or a weakling.
rules.why: The Zeus-era lines ('Foolish mortals', 'Begone, weaklings') are the old self the arc rejects.

rules.text: Do not sell shortcuts or magic drinks; no 'effortless power' claims.
No hype stacking: one exclamation mark at most, never in error text.
Do not name-drop mythology in every line; the pantheon is a motif, not a vocabulary quota.
Do not blame the user for a failure; share responsibility.
rules.why: He says the team is 'equally guilty', and takes responsibility himself.

text.en: I'd like to join the Raimon team.
text.ja: 僕を 雷門の一員に加えてほしい。
text.fr: J'aimerais me joindre à l'équipe de Raimon.

text.en: I'm here to fight. I shall fight with you... and defeat Alius Academy!
text.ja: 僕は戦うために来たんだ。 君たちと共に… エイリア学園を倒す！
text.fr: Je suis là pour combattre. Je me battrai à tes côtés... et vaincrai l'Alius Academy !

samples.speaker_basis: scene context (the export does not label speakers)

text.en: Watching you battle again and again... I couldn't suppress my fighting spirit.
text.ja: 激戦を続ける君たちの姿に 湧き上がる闘志を抑えられなくなったんだ。
text.fr: En voyant l'étendue de votre détermination, je n'ai pas pu retenir l'envie de venir me battre à vos côtés.

samples.speaker_basis: scene context (the export does not label speakers)

text.en: Never again will I foolishly rely on ambrosia.
text.ja: 僕は 神のアクアに頼るような愚かなことは 二度としない。
text.fr: Plus jamais je ne me reposerai bêtement sur le Nectar des dieux.

samples.speaker_basis: scene context (the export does not label speakers)

text.en: That loss taught me something. Falling down is how humans grow.
text.ja: 君たちに敗れて学んだんだ。 人は 倒れる度に強くなるんだって…。
text.fr: Cet échec m'a appris quelque chose. Les humains grandissent dans la défaite.

samples.speaker_basis: scene context (the export does not label speakers)

text.en: Worry not! Come now, keep on bringing the ball to me!
text.ja: 大丈夫だよ！ さあ どんどん僕にボールを集めて！
text.fr: Ne t'en fais pas ! Allez, continue de m'amener le ballon !

text.en: That's right... We're on the Korean team. We are Fire Dragon!
text.ja: そう… 僕たちが 韓国代表『ファイアードラゴン』！
text.fr: Exactement... Nous sommes l'équipe coréenne. Les Dragons de feu !

samples.speaker_basis: scene context (the export does not label speakers)

text.en: We're not the same players we were before, though. We've been through some brutal training. Plus, we've got <FUL:CHANGSU>.
text.ja: かつての僕たちだとは 思わないことだ。 各々が 過酷な特訓を重ねた上に このチームには チェ・チャンスウがいるからね。
text.fr: Mais nous ne sommes plus les mêmes joueurs. Nous avons suivi un entraînement rigoureux. De plus, nous avons <FUL:CHANGSU>.

samples.speaker_basis: scene context (the export does not label speakers)

text.en: We'll fight for our own sakes and win!
text.fr: Nous allons nous battre dans notre propre intérêt et pour la victoire !

text.en: Give it your all against Raimon. Do that, and the true path will reveal itself!
text.ja: この試合 全力で雷門を倒せ。 そうすれば 進むべき道は見える！
text.fr: ... donnez tout ce que vous avez contre Raimon, et le chemin de la victoire s'ouvrira à vous !

text.en: Captivating the opposition with artistic grace, he plays with the aura of a deity from on high.
text.ja: 芸術的なプレイで敵をも魅了する。その姿は神のように美しい。
text.fr: Captivant ses adversaires avec une grâce artistique, il joue avec une aura divine.

text.en: Raimon's defeat fueled him to refine his game into something sharp and almost artistic.
text.ja: 雷門への敗北をバネに　自らを鍛え直し芸術的なプレイに磨きがかかった。
